Poetry.t: I will speak of Your testimonies also before kings, And will not be ashamed.
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects; Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
My help comes from the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
Open rebuke is better Than love carefully concealed.
He heals the brokenhearted And binds up their wounds.
Do not forsake me, O Lord; O my God, be not far from me!
Pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You are my strength.
Deliver me in Your righteousness, and cause me to escape; Incline Your ear to me, and save me.
Save Me from the lion’s mouth And from the horns of the wild oxen! You have answered Me.
Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases,
The wise in heart will receive commands, But a prating fool will fall.
I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the Lord.
Remember me, O Lord, with the favor You have toward Your people. Oh, visit me with Your salvation,
The Lord shall preserve your going out and your coming in From this time forth, and even forevermore.
And I will delight myself in Your commandments, Which I love.
O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
I hate the double-minded, But I love Your law.
Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous! For praise from the upright is beautiful.
Do you see a man who excels in his work? He will stand before kings; He will not stand before unknown men.
He who walks with wise men will be wise, But the companion of fools will be destroyed.
Who among all these does not know That the hand of the Lord has done this,
Bow down Your ear to me, Deliver me speedily; Be my rock of refuge, A fortress of defense to save me.
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord, O my soul!
Righteousness guards him whose way is blameless, But wickedness overthrows the sinner.
The generous soul will be made rich, And he who waters will also be watered himself.
The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, And He delights in his way.
He who has a generous eye will be blessed, For he gives of his bread to the poor.
O Lord of hosts, Blessed is the man who trusts in You!
I cry out to You; Save me, and I will keep Your testimonies.
I will walk before the Lord In the land of the living.
Hope deferred makes the heart sick, But when the desire comes, it is a tree of life.
I am small and despised, Yet I do not forget Your precepts.
Whenever I am afraid, I will trust in You.
Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom; I am understanding, I have strength.
Be diligent to know the state of your flocks, And attend to your herds;
Two are better than one, Because they have a good reward for their labor.
O You who hear prayer, To You all flesh will come.
He who earnestly seeks good finds favor, But trouble will come to him who seeks evil.
I will fetch my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
My soul follows close behind You; Your right hand upholds me.
“I will teach you about the hand of God; What is with the Almighty I will not conceal.
Who has preceded Me, that I should pay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
The poor shall eat and be satisfied; Those who seek Him will praise the Lord. Let your heart live forever!
And after my skin is destroyed, this I know, That in my flesh I shall see God,
When my father and my mother forsake me, Then the Lord will take care of me.
But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; He is their strength in the time of trouble.
For I will not trust in my bow, Nor shall my sword save me.
Praise the Lord with the harp; Make melody to Him with an instrument of ten strings.
The way of the Lord is strength for the upright, But destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.
The wicked man does deceptive work, But he who sows righteousness will have a sure reward.
If they obey and serve Him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.
Teach me, O Lord, the way of Your statutes, And I shall keep it to the end.
No one is so fierce that he would dare stir him up. Who then is able to stand against Me?
For surely there is a hereafter, And your hope will not be cut off.
Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer; And attend to the voice of my supplications.
But I will hope continually, And will praise You yet more and more.
Those who sow in tears Shall reap in joy.
If iniquity were in your hand, and you put it far away, And would not let wickedness dwell in your tents;
He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord, But those who deal truthfully are His delight.
The voice of rejoicing and salvation Is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
Consider how I love Your precepts; Revive me, O Lord, according to Your lovingkindness.
Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding, But what is in the heart of fools is made known.
Let not mercy and truth forsake you; Bind them around your neck, Write them on the tablet of your heart,
Does not wisdom cry out, And understanding lift up her voice?
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in the Lord his God,
But You, O Lord, do not be far from Me; O My Strength, hasten to help Me!
Many seek the ruler’s favor, But justice for man comes from the Lord.
Offer to God thanksgiving, And pay your vows to the Most High.
The Lord is in His holy temple, The Lord’s throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, His eyelids test the sons of men.
Through God we will do valiantly, For it is He who shall tread down our enemies.
“Can you draw out Leviathan with a hook, Or snare his tongue with a line which you lower?
My defense is of God, Who saves the upright in heart.
God thunders marvelously with His voice; He does great things which we cannot comprehend.
Arise for our help, And redeem us for Your mercies’ sake.
The hand of the diligent will rule, But the lazy man will be put to forced labor.
For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.
So that your trust may be in the Lord; I have instructed you today, even you.
Delight yourself also in the Lord, And He shall give you the desires of your heart.
Sing out the honor of His name; Make His praise glorious.
Better is a little with the fear of the Lord, Than great treasure with trouble.
“Behold, I am vile; What shall I answer You? I lay my hand over my mouth.
You have commanded us To keep Your precepts diligently.
He will not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord.
Blessed are You, O Lord! Teach me Your statutes.
He sent His word and healed them, And delivered them from their destructions.
I will meditate on the glorious splendor of Your majesty, And on Your wondrous works.
That the hypocrite should not reign, Lest the people be ensnared.
O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob! Selah
“I know that You can do everything, And that no purpose of Yours can be withheld from You.
As iron sharpens iron, So a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, But fools despise wisdom and instruction.
Understanding is a wellspring of life to him who has it. But the correction of fools is folly.
How fair and how pleasant you are, O love, with your delights!
Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good; Sing praises to His name, for it is pleasant.
He who keeps his command will experience nothing harmful; And a wise man’s heart discerns both time and judgment,
Blessed is that man who makes the Lord his trust, And does not respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
Blessed are those who keep His testimonies, Who seek Him with the whole heart!
I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in right paths.
May you be blessed by the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
My mercy I will keep for him forever, And My covenant shall stand firm with him.
My hands also I will lift up to Your commandments, Which I love, And I will meditate on Your statutes. ז Zᴀʏɪɴ
A wise man will hear and increase learning, And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel,
Blessed is the man who listens to me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.
The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom, And before honor is humility.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue, And those who love it will eat its fruit.
Go, eat your bread with joy, And drink your wine with a merry heart; For God has already accepted your works.
His work is honorable and glorious, And His righteousness endures forever.
To You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
It is better to trust in the Lord Than to put confidence in man.
Did not He who made me in the womb make them? Did not the same One fashion us in the womb?
Commit your way to the Lord, Trust also in Him, And He shall bring it to pass.
“I have heard of You by the hearing of the ear, But now my eye sees You.
He does not preserve the life of the wicked, But gives justice to the oppressed.
He shall deliver you in six troubles, Yes, in seven no evil shall touch you.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Than one perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
By pride comes nothing but strife, But with the well-advised is wisdom.
But it is good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, That I may declare all Your works.
I long for Your salvation, O Lord, And Your law is my delight.
Arise, O Lord, Do not let man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Your sight.
Wisdom strengthens the wise More than ten rulers of the city.
Yet the righteous will hold to his way, And he who has clean hands will be stronger and stronger.
My beloved is white and ruddy, Chief among ten thousand.
But I am poor and sorrowful; Let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.
Their heart is as fat as grease, But I delight in Your law.
You are good, and do good; Teach me Your statutes.
Blessed are those who dwell in Your house; They will still be praising You. Selah
To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way aright, But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.
Buy the truth, and do not sell it, Also wisdom and instruction and understanding.
Great are Your tender mercies, O Lord; Revive me according to Your judgments.
Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face evermore!
The fear of the Lord prolongs days, But the years of the wicked will be shortened.
Your testimonies also are my delight And my counselors. ד Dᴀʟᴇᴛʜ
But the Lord has been my defense, And my God the rock of my refuge.
Do not lift up your horn on high; Do not speak with a stiff neck.’ ”
Blessed is the man whose strength is in You, Whose heart is set on pilgrimage.
The spirit of a man is the lamp of the Lord, Searching all the inner depths of his heart.
Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.
The way of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, But He loves him who follows righteousness.
When they cast you down, and you say, ‘Exaltation will come!’ Then He will save the humble person.
Let all the earth fear the Lord; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
I will wait for You, O You his Strength; For God is my defense.
Her feet go down to death, Her steps lay hold of hell.
Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me.”
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, But the prayer of the upright is His delight.
Do not mix with winebibbers, Or with gluttonous eaters of meat;
Keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I put my trust in You.
I will delight myself in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. ג Gɪᴍᴇʟ
He delivers the poor in their affliction, And opens their ears in oppression.
This is the gate of the Lord, Through which the righteous shall enter.
The Lord lives! Blessed be my Rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, But the Lord delivers him out of them all.
The Lord will destroy the house of the proud, But He will establish the boundary of the widow.
Depart from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
“From where then does wisdom come? And where is the place of understanding?
“Can the papyrus grow up without a marsh? Can the reeds flourish without water?
You will guide me with Your counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.
The wicked watches the righteous, And seeks to slay him.
The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, To turn one away from the snares of death.
Hatred stirs up strife, But love covers all sins.
He seals the hand of every man, That all men may know His work.
For who is God, except the Lord? And who is a rock, except our God?
Exalt the Lord our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the Lord our God is holy.
Does God subvert judgment? Or does the Almighty pervert justice?
Better not to vow than to vow and not pay.
Sing to the Lord, bless His name; Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
The voice of the Lord divides the flames of fire.
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? No one!
Like a lily among thorns, So is my love among the daughters. The Shulamite
I was mute, I did not open my mouth, Because it was You who did it.
But for him who is joined to all the living there is hope, for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
And see if there is any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
My voice You shall hear in the morning, O Lord; In the morning I will direct it to You, And I will look up.
My praise shall be of You in the great assembly; I will pay My vows before those who fear Him.
Will you show partiality for Him? Will you contend for God?
For great is Your mercy toward me, And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.
I am a wall, And my breasts like towers; Then I became in his eyes As one who found peace.
Do not envy the oppressor, And choose none of his ways;
“I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, And find out knowledge and discretion.
He will bless those who fear the Lord, Both small and great.
He catches the wise in their own craftiness, And the counsel of the cunning comes quickly upon them.
In Your name they rejoice all day long, And in Your righteousness they are exalted.
Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy.
He will redeem his soul from going down to the Pit, And his life shall see the light.
He who despises his neighbor sins; But he who has mercy on the poor, happy is he.
I cried out to You, O Lord: I said, “You are my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.
Is it not destruction for the wicked, And disaster for the workers of iniquity?
Bless the Lord, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name!
But You, O Lord, are a God full of compassion, and gracious, Longsuffering and abundant in mercy and truth.
Take away the wicked from before the king, And his throne will be established in righteousness.
Do not cast me off in the time of old age; Do not forsake me when my strength fails.
They also do no iniquity; They walk in His ways.
For the Lord takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the humble with salvation.
The righteousness of the upright will deliver them, But the unfaithful will be caught by their lust.
The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, Like the rivers of water; He turns it wherever He wishes.
I have hated those who regard useless idols; But I trust in the Lord.
The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way, But the folly of fools is deceit.
Behold, the eye of the Lord is on those who fear Him, On those who hope in His mercy,
For there is not a just man on earth who does good And does not sin.
Far be it from me That I should say you are right; Till I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
In the multitude of my anxieties within me, Your comforts delight my soul.
He shall cover you with His feathers, And under His wings you shall take refuge; His truth shall be your shield and buckler.
Blessed be the Lord God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen.
Let Israel now say, “His mercy endures forever.”
Faithful are the wounds of a friend, But the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
Your mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Without counsel, plans go awry, But in the multitude of counselors they are established.
O Israel, hope in the Lord From this time forth and forever.
He shall cry to Me, ‘You are my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.’
He mocks at fear, and is not frightened; Nor does he turn back from the sword.
Forever, O Lord, Your word is settled in heaven.
In God (I will praise His word), In God I have put my trust; I will not fear. What can flesh do to me?
Bless the Lord, O house of Levi! You who fear the Lord, bless the Lord!
Though your beginning was small, Yet your latter end would increase abundantly.
For lo, the winter is past, The rain is over and gone.
I will take up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the Lord.
“Can you search out the deep things of God? Can you find out the limits of the Almighty?
He will yet fill your mouth with laughing, And your lips with rejoicing.
Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.
Let your garments always be white, And let your head lack no oil.
I will sing to the Lord, Because He has dealt bountifully with me.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He also will hear their cry and save them.
The wicked are overthrown and are no more, But the house of the righteous will stand.
Train up a child in the way he should go, And when he is old he will not depart from it.
O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongs— O God, to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth!
No mention shall be made of coral or quartz, For the price of wisdom is above rubies.
My soul shall make its boast in the Lord; The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
Righteousness exalts a nation, But sin is a reproach to any people.
A man who has friends must himself be friendly, But there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
The right hand of the Lord is exalted; The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
Your words have upheld him who was stumbling, And you have strengthened the feeble knees;
The Lord tests the righteous, But the wicked and the one who loves violence His soul hates.
Come and hear, all you who fear God, And I will declare what He has done for my soul.
The Lord knows the thoughts of man, That they are futile.
Riches and honor are with me, Enduring riches and righteousness.
Our feet have been standing Within your gates, O Jerusalem!
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, And he who wins souls is wise.
The way of the lazy man is like a hedge of thorns, But the way of the upright is a highway.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head in the day of battle.
My soul melts from heaviness; Strengthen me according to Your word.
Return, O Lord, deliver me! Oh, save me for Your mercies’ sake!
A righteous man hates lying, But a wicked man is loathsome and comes to shame.
Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.
A time to love, And a time to hate; A time of war, And a time of peace.
Depart from me, you evildoers, For I will keep the commandments of my God!
But to You I have cried out, O Lord, And in the morning my prayer comes before You.
He who tills his land will be satisfied with bread, But he who follows frivolity is devoid of understanding.
My foot stands in an even place; In the congregations I will bless the Lord.
As for me, I will call upon God, And the Lord shall save me.
Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the Lord!
Mark the blameless man, and observe the upright; For the future of that man is peace.
Those who are of a perverse heart are an abomination to the Lord, But the blameless in their ways are His delight.
In all labor there is profit, But idle chatter leads only to poverty.
Now in my prosperity I said, “I shall never be moved.”
For in You, O Lord, I hope; You will hear, O Lord my God.
Sing to the Lord with the harp, With the harp and the sound of a psalm,
Have you heard the counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
The lips of the righteous feed many, But fools die for lack of wisdom.
Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And uphold me by Your generous Spirit.
Accept, I pray, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, And teach me Your judgments.
Your word is very pure; Therefore Your servant loves it.
My lips will not speak wickedness, Nor my tongue utter deceit.
Yet man is born to trouble, As the sparks fly upward.
Make me hear joy and gladness, That the bones You have broken may rejoice.
“Behold, God is great, and we do not know Him; Nor can the number of His years be discovered.
Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; Indeed, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
For He remembered His holy promise, And Abraham His servant.
You will arise and have mercy on Zion; For the time to favor her, Yes, the set time, has come.
You are near, O Lord, And all Your commandments are truth.
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.
Truly my soul silently waits for God; From Him comes my salvation.
Do You have eyes of flesh? Or do You see as man sees?
Bless the Lord, all you His hosts, You ministers of His, who do His pleasure.
My soul keeps Your testimonies, And I love them exceedingly.
To everything there is a season, A time for every purpose under heaven:
Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; Try my mind and my heart.
She opens her mouth with wisdom, And on her tongue is the law of kindness.
Oh, love the Lord, all you His saints! For the Lord preserves the faithful, And fully repays the proud person.
The Lord who made heaven and earth Bless you from Zion!
I will praise You with uprightness of heart, When I learn Your righteous judgments.
Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
Words of the wise, spoken quietly, should be heard Rather than the shout of a ruler of fools.
Ointment and perfume delight the heart, And the sweetness of a man’s friend gives delight by hearty counsel.
Wisdom is in the sight of him who has understanding, But the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.
I hate and abhor lying, But I love Your law.
For He bruises, but He binds up; He wounds, but His hands make whole.
Praise Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all you stars of light!
He uncovers deep things out of darkness, And brings the shadow of death to light.
Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice with the wife of your youth.
Mercy and truth have met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed.
Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.
“But where can wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?
But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave, For He shall receive me. Selah
He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength; He gallops into the clash of arms.
He who covers his sins will not prosper, But whoever confesses and forsakes them will have mercy.
To You, O my Strength, I will sing praises; For God is my defense, My God of mercy.
But You, Lord, are on high forevermore.
Evil pursues sinners, But to the righteous, good shall be repaid.
Draw near to my soul, and redeem it; Deliver me because of my enemies.
The sun to rule by day, For His mercy endures forever;
Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you; Love her, and she will keep you.
The Lord lifts up the humble; He casts the wicked down to the ground.
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher, “All is vanity.”
Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; And to him who orders his conduct aright I will show the salvation of God.”
I was eyes to the blind, And I was feet to the lame.
The earth, O Lord, is full of Your mercy; Teach me Your statutes. ט Tᴇᴛʜ
The Lord has made known His salvation; His righteousness He has revealed in the sight of the nations.
A time to tear, And a time to sew; A time to keep silence, And a time to speak;
Then you will understand righteousness and justice, Equity and every good path.
Have I not wept for him who was in trouble? Has not my soul grieved for the poor?
For He knows our frame; He remembers that we are dust.
Then I saw that wisdom excels folly As light excels darkness.
The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy endures forever.
The lazy man does not roast what he took in hunting, But diligence is man’s precious possession.
Will you keep to the old way Which wicked men have trod,
He brought me to the banqueting house, And his banner over me was love.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, And renew a steadfast spirit within me.

Major Prophets.t: The humble also shall increase their joy in the Lord, And the poor among men shall rejoice In the Holy One of Israel.
Do not be afraid of their faces, For I am with you to deliver you,” says the Lord.
“Am I a God near at hand,” says the Lord, “And not a God afar off?
“But you, go your way till the end; for you shall rest, and will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.”
Arise, shine; For your light has come! And the glory of the Lord is risen upon you.
Thus says the Lord God to these bones: “Surely I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live.
The work of righteousness will be peace, And the effect of righteousness, quietness and assurance forever.
“And He said to me, ‘You are My servant, O Israel, In whom I will be glorified.’
They shall be My people, and I will be their God;
I have seen his ways, and will heal him; I will also lead him, And restore comforts to him And to his mourners.
He reveals deep and secret things; He knows what is in the darkness, And light dwells with Him.
You drew near on the day I called on You, And said, “Do not fear!”
The grass withers, the flower fades, But the word of our God stands forever.”
Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego in the province of Babylon.
Then these men assembled and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.
Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; Save me, and I shall be saved, For You are my praise.
Then the Lord said to me, “You have seen well, for I am ready to perform My word.”
O earth, earth, earth, Hear the word of the Lord!
Zion shall be redeemed with justice, And her penitents with righteousness.
TEKEL: You have been weighed in the balances, and found wanting;
“It shall come to pass That before they call, I will answer; And while they are still speaking, I will hear.
therefore I will save My flock, and they shall no longer be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.
As for our Redeemer, the Lord of hosts is His name, The Holy One of Israel.
We acknowledge, O Lord, our wickedness And the iniquity of our fathers, For we have sinned against You.
Surely He has borne our griefs And carried our sorrows; Yet we esteemed Him stricken, Smitten by God, and afflicted.
Can anyone break iron, The northern iron and the bronze?
For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: “Break up your fallow ground, And do not sow among thorns.
Let him put his mouth in the dust— There may yet be hope.
You, O king, are a king of kings. For the God of heaven has given you a kingdom, power, strength, and glory;
Strengthen the weak hands, And make firm the feeble knees.
‘You shall be My people, And I will be your God.’ ”
Have you not brought this on yourself, In that you have forsaken the Lord your God When He led you in the way?
The Gentiles shall come to your light, And kings to the brightness of your rising.
‘Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and mighty things, which you do not know.’
Then I set my face toward the Lord God to make request by prayer and supplications, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
He shall enter into peace; They shall rest in their beds, Each one walking in his uprightness.
For I will take you from among the nations, gather you out of all countries, and bring you into your own land.
He gives power to the weak, And to those who have no might He increases strength.
I, even I, am the Lord, And besides Me there is no savior.
And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, “O Daniel, I have now come forth to give you skill to understand.
O Lord, You have pleaded the case for my soul; You have redeemed my life.
Everyone who is called by My name, Whom I have created for My glory; I have formed him, yes, I have made him.”
O Lord, You have seen how I am wronged; Judge my case.
Now from among those of the sons of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
“Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for Me?
Then you will call upon Me and go and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
Trust in the Lord forever, For in YAH, the Lord, is everlasting strength.
“Comfort, yes, comfort My people!” Says your God.
that the Lord your God may show us the way in which we should walk and the thing we should do.”
A glorious high throne from the beginning Is the place of our sanctuary.
Let him sit alone and keep silent, Because God has laid it on him;
“I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked, And I will redeem you from the grip of the terrible.”
You, O Lord, remain forever; Your throne from generation to generation.
Behold, My Servant shall deal prudently; He shall be exalted and extolled and be very high.
For thus says the Lord: “You have sold yourselves for nothing, And you shall be redeemed without money.”
And the inhabitant will not say, “I am sick”; The people who dwell in it will be forgiven their iniquity.
Fear not, for I am with you; I will bring your descendants from the east, And gather you from the west;
“At the same time,” says the Lord, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people.”
